s.t:
SUMMARY OF DUTIES: Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Smartling is seeking a French-speaking Business Development Representative for a remote, work-from-home position based in Ireland. Smartling’s Business Development team is a group of highly motivated sales professionals whose focus is to source and engage with high-potential prospects.

As the first point of contact with potential customers, you will qualify active buying interest and be a critical part of the bridge between marketing and sales to ensure new customer acquisition is consistent, high-quality, and frictionless.
Smartling is an AI-native translation platform that's redefining how the world's biggest brands go global — ranked #3 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list . We're growing rapidly at scale and are backed by Battery Ventures, a global technology-focused investment firm. While most companies are still figuring out how to use AI, we've spent years building it into the core of our platform — and we're just getting started.
What’s in it for you
Become a business representative via regular and structured coaching and training
Be a part of an ambitious and highly motivated team
You will learn vital prospecting skills and be a champion in discovery calls with prospects
Develop your core foundation and launch your career as a SaaS sales professional
Work in a fast-paced technology company
Sales performance incentives for fun (SPIFFs!)

Work alongside marketing and sales to source and engage with high-potential prospects and companies
Develop and execute outreach strategies via email, Zoom and social channels
Generate curiosity with potential customers by clearly articulating Smartling’s value proposition
Act as a consultative partner for potential customers; fielding questions and handling objections
Once prospects have been qualified and a fit has been identified, execute a hand-off to Account Executives
Diligently record and manage prospect and company information in Salesforce.com
Become a Smartling expert, maintaining an in-depth knowledge of the product, competitive positioning and industry trends
Be a Smartling ambassador at industry events and conferences
You Have
Proficiency in French
Interest in sales as a career
Track record of top performance in a competitive environment
A natural passion and curiosity for fast-paced technology
Clear communicator with a deep sense of empathy

Excellent written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
1 year customer-facing experience
A home office setup conducive for working remotely, and the ability to work effectively as a remote team member*

You Are
Results-focused. Motivated, hard-working and ready to level up to your career goals
Curious: You’re a “forever learner” with an insatiable desire to gain new skills and knowledge
Enthusiastic . A fun and energetic co-worker
Customer-focused. Passionate for client success at all times

A team-player . Who gets excited by a fast-paced, high-energy environment
You Will Enjoy
Freedom - we are remote-first
Growth - an opportunity to learn and advance your career

Sales Development Representative PayTrace - Remote The Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a crucial part of the lead generation and sales process within PayTrace and is responsible for generating leads for our Account Executive team.

The SDR will be assigned various targeted lists for outbound cold calling, developing a pipeline and generating new opportunities for sales. What you'll do: Drive top-of-the-funnel lead generation for account executives. Manage leads through the sales pipeline by setting appointments, following up on leads, and tracking progress towards sales goals.

Update and manage all sales activities, opportunities, and account information in CRM. Generate new business pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, and email campaigns.

Earn commissions by exceeding KPI’s - including outbound activity (phone/email/social messages), the number of appointments set, monthly and quarterly opportunities generated, etc.

Establish active communication and engagement with prospects to create new leads and sales opportunities Deliver high-quality professional service consistent with our core values. Stay up-to-date on market trends, industry developments, and competition. Overcome objections and communicate persuasively and effectively.

Collaborate with sales and marketing to build strategies for generating new prospects. What we need from you: High school diploma or GED. Minimum 2 years relevant work experience for SaaS company. Minimum 2 years experience in cold calling and generating new leads.

Proven record of success with developing prospecting lists and meeting or exceeding targets. Experience in the Payment Industry, SaaS, or B2B experience.

Ability to work independently with limited direction in a fast-paced environment Strong presentation and communication skills in person, via phone or online or via email with customers and prospects. Highly organized with the ability to multitask, prioritize deadlines, manage time efficiently and track data.

Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed quotas. Previous experience selling datacenter or Database-focused solutions are a plus. Prior experience with HubSpot, Zoominfo, Outreach, Slack, Google Suite, LinkedIn and other sales and marketing tools are a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A desire to learn and grow.

A collaborative spirit with excellent cross-functional working skills. Travel Requirements: Under 10% Salary range: $40,000-$55,000 base plus incentive plan. Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process. Who we are: PayTrace by North, your B2B payments experts, transforms financial and accounting processes to future-proof your business.

With advanced payment automation solutions and a user-friendly API, they help B2B companies become more efficient, successful, and profitable. Processing more than $48 billion in payment transactions, PayTrace is committed to providing easy-to-use payment solutions and merchant services, with built-in PCI compliance and security, and 5-star service.

At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal-opportunity employer. To learn more about North and our family of companies, visit our website: https://www.north.com/company/about/our-companies-brands Originally posted on Himalayas

To support One Model's continuous growth in the European market, we are seeking a dynamic and ambitious Enterprise Business Development Representative (BDR) to contribute to expanding our business.

Reporting to the Director of Business Development, the BDR will be crucial in generating new business opportunities and navigating the sales cycle, primarily with large enterprises and rapidly growing companies. We want you on our team if you possess an entrepreneurial mindset, strong technical proficiency, and enjoy building relationships.

Prospect and qualify outbound and inbound sales opportunities via cold calling, cold emailing, and social selling.
Create and execute on an effective outbound strategy in partnership with your Account Executive to win more deals.
Own your territory and approach your day to day as an Account Executive, providing weekly updates on targeted accounts, ongoing campaigns, and metric attainment to Sales Leadership and Account Executives.
Cultivate relationships with various external stakeholders meeting our business standards to book new meetings for sales representatives successfully.
Identify and comprehend prospects' challenges and requirements, aligning them with the value and features of One Model's offerings.
Work to ensure that booked meetings become held meetings and follow up with contacts who failed to show up for a meeting.
Utilize innovative technologies and creative strategies to communicate effectively with prospects.
Stay informed about trends and issues within HR technologies and people analytics.
Offer constructive feedback to product management, marketing teams, and sales leadership to enhance products and create additional value for customers.

Based in London
2+ years selling in a business-to-business (B2B) environment preferably to large enterprises across the EMEA region
Successful track record in a sales or business development role, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
Entrepreneurial approach to generating new meetings for sales teams.
Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and other sales enablement tools to manage and track leads, opportunities, and activities.
A problem solver with the ability to proactively multitask & manage multiple customer accounts.
Strong research skills to identify and qualify potential leads, understanding their business needs, challenges, and decision-making processes.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, adapt to changes, and quickly learn about new industries and technologies.
Collaborative mindset with the capacity to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, and product teams.
Growth-minded, energetic personality with a good sense of humor.

2+ years outbound selling (cold calling, cold emailing, social selling, etc.) or closing deals in a business-to-business (B2B) environment preferably to large enterprises.
Experience selling HRtech or to HR leaders.
Experience working in a hybrid or fully remote sales position.
Experience using Hubspot, Leadfeeder, Dealfront, Gong or other similar technology.
What’s In It For You
One Model, founded by industry veterans in HR analytics, boasts a strong competitive advantage with its data-first approach to the People Analytics Platform. Joining One Model means:
Flexibility to work remotely, collaborating with colleagues globally.
A friendly, inclusive, and respectful workplace culture.
The opportunity to contribute significantly to a young company and team.

s.h: Generous compensation and attractive performance pay structure.
s.t: At One Model we pride ourselves on our supportive and inclusive work environment and are confident that you will feel included here regardless of your demographic. We see the value of having a diverse workforce, which is why we encourage you to apply for the role even if you don't think you're a 'perfect fit'.

This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

As a Sales Development Representative at ScraperAPI, you'll spearhead our outbound sales efforts for our premium web scraping solution. In this crucial growth role, you'll be responsible for proactively identifying, contacting, and qualifying potential customers.
Working within our enterprise Go-to-market team, you'll drive pipeline growth through consistent prospecting and strategic account based work.

This role is ideal for a motivated sales professional who thrives on the hunt for large accounts, needs the challenge of working multiple personas in one target account and wants to deploy their skills in a supportive, autonomous environment.

With a clear pathway to earning potential, strong performers are expected to quickly learn our target persons, own their territory plan and begin speaking to prospects within weeks. We're seeking a creative, driven individual who isn't afraid to think outside the box and make this role their own.

s.h: Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 weeks will be
s.t:
Master our product offering, ideal customer profile, and qualification process
Pick up prospecting your accounts, call them, develop relevant relationships, begin developing your pipeline
Use effective outbound strategies across multiple channels to generate qualified opportunities for enterprise-level clients
Learn from your high performing peers and work cross functionally with Ops and Marketing to optimise your territory outcomes

Generate leads through proactive outbound efforts including cold calling, targeted emails, and social outreach.
Research and identify potential customers that match our ideal customer profile.
Qualify prospects through discovery conversations to understand their needs and challenges.
Schedule meetings between qualified prospects and Sales Executives, providing context and insights that help maximize closing potential.
Maintain accurate records in our CRM, ensuring the sales pipeline is clean and organised.
Become an expert on ScraperAPI’s offerings and use cases to provide relevant, compelling information to prospects.

s.h: What You bring to the table
s.t:
At least 12 months of experience in a sales role, ideally in SaaS, tech, or B2B sales.
Strong drive, creativity, and competitive spirit with the ability to think outside the box
Professional fluency in a second language, alongside English, is highly valued.
Strong understanding of the sales process, with a goal-driven attitude and the resilience to handle rejections.
Experienced with CRM systems (HubSpot) and modern sales tools, as well as data-driven sales methodologies.
Interest in technology and ability to quickly grasp our product's value proposition
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.
ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars.

With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella.

Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

We are a dynamic AI start-up based in the heart of Munich, setting the global standard for AI Coaching. While most AI companies are working on replacing human labor, we are unlocking the uniquely human strengths that drive lasting business outcomes for our enterprise clients.

Our in-house AI technology helps sales and service teams at global enterprises earn trust and win deals through realistic client simulations and deep behavioral feedback. Join our international team that is not just building a human-centric product, but redefining customer relationships.
About the role (Munich-based, German speaking): You are the tip of the spear for our enterprise motion in DACH. Paired one to one with a Senior Account Executive, you own the top of the funnel.

You research target accounts, reach the right people through cold calls, email and LinkedIn, and open conversations with senior commercial buyers in Sales Enablement and Commercial Excellence. This is a dedicated pod, not a shared pool. You feed a proven closer, learn enterprise selling from the inside, and grow into an Account Executive yourself.
Tasks
Generating qualified pipeline through proactive, multi-channel outbound: cold calls, personalized email sequences, and LinkedIn, into your target accounts
Researching accounts and buying centers, and identifying the right senior stakeholders in Sales Enablement, Commercial Excellence, and Service Ownership
Running crisp first conversations that qualify need and book meetings your paired Account Executive accepts
Working hand in hand with one senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 pod: shared account plans, daily coordination, joint territory strategy
Keeping the CRM (HubSpot) clean and disciplined, so pipeline, activities, and handoffs stay reliable
Testing and improving messaging, sequences, and target lists together with marketing and your AE
Using Retorio's own platform to sharpen your outbound and discovery skills, and to know the product you sell from the inside

2 to 4 years of B2B SaaS outbound experience as an SDR or BDR, ideally into enterprise
A track record of consistently hitting or beating pipeline and meeting targets, with real numbers you can speak to
Strong on cold outbound: you can open a cold call, steer the conversation, and handle objections without a script
Business-fluent German (C1+) and English, the role is Munich-based and sells into the DACH market
Coachable, self-driven, and resilient: you seek feedback, act on it, and stay in the game through rejection
A clear ambition to grow into an Account Executive (see the path below)
Comfortable with modern outbound tooling: CRM (HubSpot), sales engagement, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment
Bonus: experience selling into Pharma, Telco, FMCG, Insurance, Automotive, or Retail, or into sales enablement, coaching, or L&D-adjacent buyers

From the preset toggles, enable: Above-average compensation, Flexible working hours, and High-performance culture. As custom entries:
Uncapped commission with a competitive OTE: your earnings scale with the pipeline and the deals you help create
A clear path to Account Executive: this role is built as a launchpad, with a realistic move to AE in 18 to 24 months, and faster for a standout performer
A dedicated 1:1 partnership with a senior Account Executive who coaches you every week, not a shared BDR pool
Six-figure enterprise deals and reference clients across pharma, insurance, telecom, FMCG, retail and automotive
Direct access to the founders and real influence on how we sell
A product with a genuine scientific moat, built on the Warmth and Competence framework from TU Munich research, that you also use to get better yourself
A central Munich office with an international team
If you want to break into enterprise sales the right way, learning from a senior closer while building the pipeline that wins six-figure deals, send us your CV and a short note on the best cold call or outbound sequence you have run. You will hear back within a week, and the process is fast: intro call and deep dive with your future AE partner, a practical case that includes a live cold-call exercise and a conversation with a founder.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction.

Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive.

With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're in a major growth phase at Bluelight, and we're seeking a highly driven Business Development Representative (BDR) with strong outbound sales experience to expand our client base. This role is focused on high-volume outbound prospecting, cold outreach, and booking qualified appointments.

The ideal candidate is confident speaking with U.S.-based decision-makers, has excellent English communication skills, and thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment.

What You'll Do Execute high-volume outbound prospecting daily (80–150+ activities/day) via cold calls, cold email, LinkedIn, and SMS Use HubSpot to manage daily outreach including call tasks, email cadences, and follow-ups Build and manage targeted prospect lists using Apollo and Clay, aligned with Bluelight's ideal customer profile Run structured multi-touch outbound sequences in Instantly to engage prospects and drive responses Write and send high-converting outbound emails and LinkedIn messages with strong personalization and clear calls-to-action Initiate outbound conversations with confidence, clearly communicating Bluelight's value proposition within the first few seconds Qualify prospects based on defined criteria (budget, authority, need, timeline) and identify real sales opportunities Handle objections effectively and position Bluelight as a solution to prospects' software and technology needs Book qualified discovery calls for Account Executives and ensure strong show rates through proper follow-up Accurately log all activities, notes, and pipeline updates in HubSpot Continuously improve messaging and outreach strategies based on results Meet or exceed KPIs including daily activity targets, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline contribution What We're Looking For Proven experience in B2B sales or inside sales roles, preferably within technology or software industries Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers confidently Familiarity with CRM software such as Salesforce or similar platforms Experience in telemarketing or outbound calling campaigns is highly desirable Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with a customer service-oriented approach Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment Nice to Have Apollo - for prospecting and lead discovery Clay - for building enriched, targeted outreach lists Instantly - for outbound email sequences and cadences Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and improve outreach performance What Success Looks Like Hitting daily activity and meeting targets Generating high-quality, qualified meetings Building a consistent and predictable pipeline Clearly communicating Bluelight's value Company Benefits Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

Generous paid-time-off policy Flexible working hours Work remotely Continuing education, training, conferences Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice.

Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth.

You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. Originally posted on Himalayas

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1 st , 2026, you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Institutional & Specialty divisions, Ecolab offers comprehensive chemical products and solutions to meet the needs of customers across the foodservice and hospitality industries as well as laundry, long-term care, education, corporate and government facilities.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and advisor to your customers. You will serve as the face of Ecolab, providing recommendations on advanced cleaning and sanitation processes and programs that drive a positive guest experience and create cleaner, safer, and healthier environments.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn customers’ ware washing & laundry systems and work hands‑on with equipment, learning installation, maintenance and safe use, ensuring that your customers’ facilities are fully operational and teams are properly trained
Gradually build confidence in identifying new opportunities and growing your territory providing customers with training, regular and emergency service and sales demonstrations
Coordinate sales and service activities with cross divisional peers and internal functions (e.g. Marketing Services, Customer Service).
Reach out to potential customers to secure new accounts, as you build Ecolab’s brand in your market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:

s.h: Have completed vocational training or equivalent education
s.t:
Have some experience in customer‑facing, sales, service or hospitality environments, preferably business to business commercial sales experience
Have basic installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting skills
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have a desire to grow your career in Sales and Service-related roles
Have basic IT skills (CRM experience is helpful) Hold a valid driver's license and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record and are open to travelling within your allocated district and nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12‑month fixed‑term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business need
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday
4% Flexible Benefits Allowance. A wide range of benefits (extended to families) or to be used as salary increase
Pension with 7% Employer Contribution and 4 x annual salary Life Insurance benefits
Receive a company vehicle for business and personal use
Income growth opportunities as you progress and develop in the role
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants.

We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance.

In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, colour, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

Als Sales Development Representative (all genders) bist du ein wichtiger Teil dieses Wachstums. Du verkaufst nicht einfach ein einzelnes Produkt. Du identifizierst, welche unserer Lösungen für welchen Kunden den größten Mehrwert schaffen, erreichst die richtigen Entscheider und entwickelst daraus qualifizierte Sales Opportunities für unsere Account Executives.
What you build
Bei Wemolo ist SDR kein Endpunkt. Es ist dein Einstieg in eine nachhaltige Sales-Karriere.
Du entwickelst genau die Fähigkeiten, die erfolgreiche Account Executives auszeichnen: Prospecting · Account Research · Discovery · Value Selling · Objection Handling · Pipeline Management · Account Strategy
Von Anfang an bekommst du dafür ein strukturiertes Onboarding, regelmäßiges Coaching und direktes Feedback. Du lernst von erfahrenen Sales-Kolleg:innen, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine eigene Pipeline und weißt jederzeit, woran du arbeiten kannst.
Deine Performance entscheidet mit darüber, wie schnell du dich weiterentwickelst.
What to expect
Lead Generation: Durch deine sichere Kommunikation baust du telefonisch, per E-Mail oder via LinkedIn Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden auf, präsentierst unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen und weckst ihr Interesse.
Marktanalyse: Du recherchierst und analysierst den deutschen Markt, um zukünftige Kunden zu identifizieren.
Networking: Du entwickelst eigene Ansprachestrategien, um dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich zu erweitern.
Stakeholder Management: Du pflegst den Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden, beantwortest ihre Fragen, stellst weitere Informationen bereit und baust dadurch eine verlässliche Beziehung auf.
Support Sales: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team, indem du Termine koordinierst und vorbereitest sowie bei anfallenden Maßnahmen wie der Erstellung von Unterlagen mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und bestehende Key Accounts weiter auszubauen.
Unternehmenswachstum: Du trägst maßgeblich zum Wachstum, Erfolg und zur Marktdurchdringung von Wemolo bei.

Bei uns steht dein Potenzial und deine Motivation im Vordergrund.

# Un conseiller ou une conseillère en réinsertion pour le bureau AI #
## Temps de travail : 80 % - 100 % ##
L-assurance invalidité (AI) est une assurance sociale obligatoire à l-échelle suisse. Elle soutient les personnes assurées menacées ou touchées par une invalidité par des mesures de réinsertion. L-objectif est que les personnes assurées puissent assurer leur subsistance de manière autonome, totalement ou partiellement. Si une telle réinsertion (ou réintégration) n-est pas ou seulement partiellement possible, l-AI verse une rente (partielle).
Tâches
* Soutien aux personnes avec des limitations de santé pour le maintien de l-emploi ou la recherche d-un poste
* Conduite d-entretiens avec les personnes concernées, les partenaires et les employeurs
* Élaboration d-analyses de situation, de problèmes et de ressources
* Planification de la réinsertion et traitement des décisions d-octroi ou de refus de prestations
* Gestion des dossiers de réinsertion
* Accompagnement des personnes concernées et coordination de tous les intervenants
* Activité sur le terrain dans le canton des Grisons
Exigences
* Personnalité intégrative avec expérience en intégration professionnelle ou assurances sociales
* Formation achevée en coaching/gestion de cas un atout
* Connaissances médicales un atout
* Résistant, sûr de soi en négociation, efficace, orienté client et objectif
* Expression orale et écrite assurée dans les langues cantonales
* Bonnes connaissances informatiques
* Ouverture, communication et esprit d-équipe constructif
* Permis de conduire et véhicule personnel pour l-activité sur le terrain

Eventbrite is disrupting a huge industry in desperate need of a shakeup. We're looking for a talented, driven and collaborative Business development manager to be the first point of contact for our sales efforts, generating demand and building a pipeline for our Account executives.

s.h: A few examples of your responsibilities
s.t:
Support the B2B Sales Function. Joining a fast-moving team and helping us scale a world-class sales organization to its next level, you'll focus on executing and optimizing our sales processes, managing client relationships, and dricing measureable results in enterprise sales.
Go after high-potential leads. Identify and cold-call on-target businesses to build a portfolio of respected, revenue-driving corporate clients.
Learn the industry inside and out. Understand the incentives, pressure points, and decision-makers of your industry so you can build profitable relationships.
Work closely with the product. Speak about it with clarity and confidence. Gather feedback from clients and share input to help shape future development.
Follow the data. Keep a close eye on performance metrics to gauge impact and zero in on the highest-value opportunities.
Stand out at every touchpoint. Deliver outstanding service that builds trust with every client interaction.
What we look for
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

An exceptional opportunity for growth . We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
Competitive pay. Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience a base salary of $70,173 to $91,661 in the US, with an additional performance-based variable compensation component. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact.
Commitment & contract
Permanent. Full-time.
Location
Fully remote.
The selection process
If you pass our screening, we’ll invite you to a couple of interviews, designed to assess your motivation, ambitions, and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Interviews are a two-way conversation: a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to learn more about the company. So make the most of it—ask questions, dig into the way we work, and hear directly from the people you’re going to meet.
We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.
Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Die **Koi\-Breeder AG** ist ein führendes Handels\- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen für Koi, Teichfische, Teichbau und Teichtechnik. Mit unserem Fachgeschäft, einem erfolgreichen Onlineshop und einem umfassenden Sortiment beraten wir unsere Kundschaft kompetent und persönlich.

Ihre Aufgaben im Innendienst
----------------------------
Als Verkaufsberater/in Innendienst \& CRM sind Sie ein zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und unterstützen den reibungslosen Ablauf unserer Verkaufsprozesse. Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
* Kompetente und lösungsorientierte Beratung unserer Kunden am Telefon, per E\-Mail und online zu Teichbau, Teichtechnik, Wasserpflege und Fischhaltung.
* Erstellung von Angeboten sowie aktive Nachverfolgung von Kundenanfragen und Offerten bis zum Verkaufsabschluss.
* Erkennen von Kundenbedürfnissen und Verkaufschancen sowie Empfehlung passender Produkte und Lösungen.
* Selbstständige Bearbeitung und Koordination von Kundenaufträgen.
* Konsequente Erfassung und Pflege von Kundendaten, Verkaufschancen und Aktivitäten in unserem CRM\-System.
* Bearbeitung der im Verkaufsinnendienst anfallenden administrativen Aufgaben.
* Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Verkaufsprozesse sowie in internen Projekten.
Was Sie mitbringen
------------------
* Erfahrung im Verkaufsinnendienst, in der Kundenberatung oder im Vertrieb – idealerweise mit technisch erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten.
* Ausgeprägte Kunden\- und Verkaufsorientierung sowie Freude daran, Kundenbedürfnisse zu erkennen und passende Lösungen zu finden.
* Technisches Interesse und die Bereitschaft, sich fundiertes Fachwissen zu unseren Produkten und deren Anwendungen anzueignen.
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM\- oder ERP\-Systemen sowie gute Kenntnisse der gängigen MS Office\-Anwendungen.
* Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit konsequenter Nachverfolgung offener Kundenanfragen und Verkaufschancen.
* Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt – telefonisch, schriftlich und online.
* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Ihre Vorteile bei Koi\-Breeder AG
---------------------------------

============================
Nous sommes une entreprise orientée vers le marché et les besoins de nos clients. Avec créativité et engagement, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour proposer à nos partenaires commerciaux et à nos clients de projets non seulement des produits de qualité, mais surtout des solutions parfaitement adaptées à leurs besoins.
La fiabilité dans nos relations commerciales crée la confiance – une valeur à laquelle nous accordons une importance particulière.
Afin de renforcer notre équipe de vente externe, nous recherchons, de suite ou à convenir, une personne pour le poste de :
Conseiller technique de vente externe (h/f/d)
pour le secteur : toute la Suisse romande ainsi que Berne jusqu’à Bâle
Vous êtes responsable de la gestion de la clientèle et de la vente de nos produits dans votre secteur. Chez nous, le client est au centre de toutes nos préoccupations. Suivi et gestion des clients existants dans votre secteur

Acquisition de nouveaux clients
